about.title: A marketplace built for everyday needs.
about.content: Samexxa is a consumer marketplace operated by Tejarpan Private Limited, created to make everyday discovery, local shopping and digital commerce simpler. Samexxa is designed to connect customers with products, local businesses and trusted sellers through a convenient online experience. We aim to help businesses build digital visibility while giving customers an easier way to discover products, offers and services.

sections.title: Our mission
sections.content: Our mission is to make digital commerce more accessible for customers and businesses across India by combining marketplace discovery, local commerce and a simple customer experience.

sections.title: Our marketplace
sections.content: Samexxa may facilitate discovery, ordering, communication and payment for eligible products or services offered through the platform. Availability, pricing, delivery, warranty, return and product-specific terms may vary by seller and product.

sections.title: Payments
sections.content: Payments on Samexxa may be processed through authorised third-party payment gateway providers, including Razorpay and Cashfree, depending on the payment flow available at the time of purchase. Payment credentials such as full card numbers, CVV and banking passwords are not intended to be stored by Samexxa. Customers may be redirected to or served by the payment provider's secure interface and are also subject to that provider's applicable terms and privacy notices.

sections.title: Trust and support
sections.content: We seek to provide clear product information, applicable pricing, seller information and customer support channels. If you have a payment, order, delivery, cancellation or refund concern, please contact Samexxa through the Contact Us page with the relevant order or payment reference.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
Last updated: 5 September 2026

These Terms & Conditions govern access to and use of the Samexxa website, marketplace, related services and payment-enabled customer experiences (collectively, the Services). The Services are operated by Tejarpan Private Limited (Tejarpan, Company, we, us or our). By accessing or using the Services, placing an order, submitting an enquiry or completing a payment, you agree to these Terms and the policies referenced here. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

1. Company and marketplace
Samexxa is the consumer-facing marketplace brand of Tejarpan Private Limited. Samexxa may provide marketplace discovery, seller information, product/service information, promotions, ordering and related customer support. Depending on the transaction, the seller or service provider may remain responsible for fulfilment, product quality, warranties, delivery and other obligations specifically applicable to the purchased product or service.

2. Eligibility and account information
You must provide accurate and current information when requested. You are responsible for activity performed through your account or contact details and must not use the Services for unlawful, fraudulent, abusive or unauthorised activities.

3. Product, seller and pricing information
Product descriptions, images, specifications, availability, seller details, prices, discounts, taxes, delivery charges and estimated delivery times may change. We make reasonable efforts to keep information accurate, but errors or omissions may occur. A seller-specific policy may apply where stated.

4. Orders and acceptance
Submitting an order or payment request is an offer to purchase the selected product or service. An order may be accepted, rejected or cancelled where permitted by applicable law or because of stock availability, pricing errors, suspected fraud, seller restrictions, payment failure or other legitimate operational reasons.

5. Payments and payment gateways
Samexxa may use third-party payment gateway providers such as Razorpay and Cashfree to facilitate online payments. The available payment methods may include cards, UPI, net banking, wallets or other methods enabled by the payment provider. Payment processing is subject to the applicable payment gateway's terms, security controls and banking/network rules. Samexxa does not request or intentionally store your complete card number, CVV, PIN, OTP, internet banking password or other confidential payment authentication credentials. Never share an OTP, PIN, CVV or password with Samexxa personnel. A successful payment does not by itself guarantee order acceptance or fulfilment where an order is subsequently rejected under these Terms.

6. Payment confirmation, failed and duplicate transactions
A transaction may be marked successful only after confirmation is received from the applicable payment gateway and/or banking network. If your account is debited but the order is not confirmed, please contact us with the transaction/payment reference. Duplicate or incorrectly captured amounts will be investigated and, where eligible, refunded in accordance with our Return & Refund Policy and applicable payment-provider processes.

7. Cancellation, returns and refunds
Cancellation, return and refund rights depend on the product/service, seller terms and applicable law. The current Return & Refund Policy forms part of these Terms. Refunds, where approved, are normally initiated to the original payment method unless applicable law, payment-provider rules or the transaction flow requires another method. Bank or payment-provider processing time is outside our direct control.

8. Delivery and fulfilment
Delivery availability, charges and timelines vary by seller, product and service location. Customers should review the applicable delivery information before completing a purchase. Delays may occur due to logistics, weather, holidays, public events, force majeure or circumstances outside reasonable control.

9. Promotions and offers
Offers may have additional eligibility, validity, minimum order, payment-method, seller or geographic conditions. Unless expressly stated, offers cannot be exchanged for cash and may not be combined.

10. Prohibited use and fraud prevention
You must not use the Services for fraud, money laundering, impersonation, unauthorised transactions, abuse of promotions, infringement of intellectual property, distribution of unlawful content or any activity prohibited by applicable law. We may suspend or cancel transactions where reasonably necessary for security, compliance or fraud prevention.

11. Intellectual property
The Samexxa brand, website design, text, graphics, logos and other platform materials are owned by or licensed to Tejarpan Private Limited or their respective rights holders and may not be copied or commercially exploited without permission.

12. Third-party services
The Services may contain links or integrations with third parties, including payment gateways, logistics providers, app stores, analytics providers and seller services. Their services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies. Razorpay and Cashfree are independent payment service providers and are not the seller of products listed on Samexxa.

13. Disclaimer and limitation
To the extent permitted by applicable law, Samexxa does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of the website, payment networks, banking systems or third-party services. Nothing in these Terms excludes rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

14. Changes
We may update these Terms from time to time. Updated Terms will be published on this page with a revised effective/updated date. Continued use after publication constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms to the extent permitted by law.

15. Governing law and jurisdiction
These Terms are intended to be governed by the laws of India. Subject to applicable law and mandatory consumer remedies, disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts having jurisdiction over the Company's applicable place of business.

16. Contact and grievances
For questions about orders, payments, cancellations or refunds, use the Contact Us page and provide your name, contact details and relevant order/payment reference. Please do not send card numbers, CVV, OTPs, PINs or passwords in a support request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Last updated: 5 September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Tejarpan Private Limited, operating the Samexxa brand, may collect, use, disclose, retain and protect information when you visit or use the Samexxa website, marketplace and related services. This policy should be read together with our Terms & Conditions and Return & Refund Policy.

1. Information we may collect
Depending on how you use Samexxa, we may collect information such as your name, mobile number, email address, delivery/contact address, account information, order information, seller interactions, enquiry details, transaction identifiers, payment status, device/browser information, IP address, cookies and similar technical information. We do not ask customers to submit card PINs, CVVs, OTPs or banking passwords to us.

2. How we use information
We may use information to provide and improve the Services; create or manage accounts; process and confirm orders; communicate about orders, payments, delivery, cancellations and refunds; respond to support requests; prevent fraud and abuse; maintain security; comply with legal obligations; improve products and user experience; and send promotional communications where permitted by applicable law and subject to available preferences/consent requirements.

3. Payment information and Razorpay/Cashfree
Online payments may be processed through third-party payment gateway providers, including Razorpay and Cashfree. Depending on the payment method, relevant information such as customer identity/contact information, order details, transaction amount, payment status and transaction/reference identifiers may be shared with the applicable payment provider to facilitate payment processing, fraud/risk checks, reconciliation, refunds, disputes and compliance. Payment providers may collect and process payment instrument or authentication information directly through their secure systems. Samexxa does not intentionally store complete card numbers, CVV, UPI PIN, OTP or internet banking passwords. Payment providers process data under their own applicable privacy notices and terms.

4. Cookies and technical information
We may use cookies, local storage and similar technologies for essential functionality, preferences, security, analytics or service improvement. You can manage cookies through your browser settings, although disabling certain technologies may affect functionality.

5. Sharing and disclosure
We may share information with sellers/service providers involved in fulfilment, payment gateway providers, delivery/logistics partners, technology/service providers, professional advisers, auditors, regulators, law-enforcement authorities where legally required, and other parties where necessary to provide the Services or protect rights and safety. We do not authorise third parties to use personal information for unrelated purposes merely because they receive it for providing a service.

6. Data security
We use reasonable technical and organisational measures appropriate to the nature of the information and the Services. However, no website, internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Please never share OTPs, PINs, CVVs, passwords or payment authentication credentials with anyone claiming to represent Samexxa.

7. Data retention
We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including order fulfilment, customer support, accounting, reconciliation, fraud prevention, dispute handling, legal and regulatory requirements and legitimate business records. Retention periods may vary depending on the category of information and applicable law.

8. Your rights and choices
Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction or deletion of certain personal information, withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, or raise a privacy concern. Some information may need to be retained to comply with legal, accounting, security or dispute-resolution obligations.

9. Children's privacy
The Services are not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable law. If you believe a child has provided personal information improperly, please contact us so that the matter can be reviewed.

10. Third-party websites and services
The website may link to or integrate with third-party services, including payment gateways, app stores, social platforms and logistics providers. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.

11. Policy updates
We may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be published on this page with an updated date.

12. Contact
For privacy questions or requests, please use the Contact Us page. Do not include passwords, OTPs, CVVs, PINs or complete payment-card details in correspondence.

refund.title: Return & Refund Policy
refund.content:
Last updated: 5 September 2026

This Return & Refund Policy applies to purchases and services made through Samexxa, operated by Tejarpan Private Limited. Product/service-specific terms shown at checkout or supplied by the seller may provide additional conditions. Where a specific seller policy conflicts with a mandatory right under applicable law, the mandatory right will prevail.

1. Cancellation before fulfilment
A customer may request cancellation before fulfilment where cancellation is available for the relevant product/service. Cancellation may not be possible once an order has been shipped, delivered to a service provider, consumed, customised or otherwise entered a non-cancellable stage.

2. Returns
Return eligibility depends on product category, seller policy, condition of the product and applicable law. Where returns are permitted, the product may need to be unused, in original condition and accompanied by relevant packaging, accessories, invoices or other documentation. Certain products/services may be non-returnable for reasons including hygiene, customisation, perishability, digital delivery or where the seller's disclosed policy permits no return, subject to applicable law.

3. Damaged, defective or incorrect items
If an item is damaged, defective, incomplete or materially different from the confirmed order, contact Samexxa promptly through the Contact Us page with the order reference and relevant evidence such as photographs where appropriate. We may coordinate with the seller or fulfilment partner to investigate and resolve the issue.

4. Refund eligibility
Approved refunds may arise from eligible cancellations, approved returns, failed fulfilment, duplicate payment, incorrect capture or other circumstances recognised under the applicable order/seller terms and law. A refund is not automatically due merely because a customer changes their mind where the product/service terms do not permit cancellation or return.

5. Payment gateway processing
Payments may be processed through Razorpay or Cashfree. Once Tejarpan/Samexxa approves a refund, the refund request may be initiated through the applicable payment gateway. Razorpay's customer guidance states that customers should contact the business for a refund and that the payment provider facilitates payment/refund processing; Cashfree similarly provides payment services while merchant product/refund matters remain governed by the merchant's policies. Refund processing time depends on the payment method, bank/card issuer and payment gateway. As a general operational estimate, normal gateway refunds can take several working days to appear in the original account; customers should rely on the refund/reference confirmation and their bank's actual posting time.

6. Refund method
Unless otherwise required or agreed under applicable rules, approved refunds are returned to the original payment instrument/payment method used for the transaction. We may request additional information needed to verify the transaction or prevent fraud.

7. Failed, pending or reversed payments
If a payment is debited but the order is not confirmed, please contact us with the payment/order reference. We will verify the transaction status with the applicable gateway and banking/payment network. If the transaction is confirmed as failed or reversed and funds are due back, the applicable gateway/bank process will be followed.

8. Duplicate payments
If you believe you were charged twice for the same order, contact us with both transaction references. After verification, any confirmed duplicate amount will be handled according to the applicable refund process.

9. Refund deductions
Where legally permitted and clearly disclosed, applicable delivery charges, payment-related charges that are non-refundable, restocking charges or other transaction-specific amounts may be deducted from an approved refund. No deduction will be made where prohibited by applicable law.

10. Disputes and chargebacks
Customers should first contact Samexxa to resolve payment or order concerns. Where a card, UPI or other payment dispute/chargeback is raised through a bank or payment network, we may provide relevant transaction and order information to the applicable payment provider or financial institution as required for investigation and dispute resolution.

11. How to request a refund
Use the Contact Us page and provide your name, registered mobile/email, order number, reason for the request and payment/transaction reference where available. Never send OTPs, PINs, CVVs, passwords or complete card numbers.

12. Policy changes
We may update this policy from time to time. The version published on this page applies to transactions subject to its effective date, while mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

Payment-provider note: Razorpay and Cashfree are third-party payment service providers. Their respective terms, privacy notices, banking/network rules and processing timelines may also apply to payment transactions. Samexxa/Tejarpan Private Limited remains responsible for its own disclosed cancellation, return and refund decisions.
